blocks_9: Narrow (760 px) layouts are not adapted: the 232 px list column stays fixed, names truncate to 'Katherine Jo...', the hover toolbar is clipped under the header in channel-narrow, and the per-person call/video buttons disappear in calls-narrow

Light mode: the quote block background (#eeeef0) is identical to the hovered-message background (#eeeef0), so the quote card vanishes on hover (chats, chat-filter-no-match); dark keeps them distinct (#2c2d33 vs #25262b)

Inconsistent rhythm in the same component: card body leading is 20 px (signin, setup), 23 px (signin-device-code) and 17 px (signin-finishing); button side padding is 16 px ('Sign in with Microsoft') vs 9-10 px ('Open the page again', 'Copy link')

Large dead bands: ~100 px empty above the conversation in chats-wide and ~200 px in call-bar/call-docked, while the image preview and dialogs hug the top (y=25 to 120) instead of sitting at a consistent optical centre

Stray-looking chrome: a 3x14 px detached scrollbar thumb beside the attach icon in composer-long-draft reads as a caret; the settings dialog shows a heavy 6 px #7c7f87 thumb and a half-clipped checkbox at its bottom edge with no fade

Light accent #9c4b0c is a muddy rust and sits close in hue to the away/BRB amber #8a5a00, so presence badges and unread accents blur together; the dark accent #e88c3e is a clearly different, brighter orange (weak light/dark parity)

Content/state logic visible in the UI: calendar lists 'Focus time 14:00 (in 3 min)' after 'Design review 14:21'; error-toast list row says 'Not sent' but previews Ada's older message instead of the failed draft

top_issues.issue: Narrow windows keep the 232 px list column and drop or clip controls
top_issues.evidence: At 760 px the list stays 64-296 px; names truncate after ~11 characters; channel-narrow hover toolbar top border cut at y~58 under the header; calls-narrow loses the phone/video buttons for every person
top_issues.fix: Below ~900 px shrink the list column to 200 px and hide previews' timestamps to one line, or collapse to a single-pane navigation; clamp the hover toolbar to y >= header bottom + 4 px; keep call buttons as 28 px icon buttons or move them into a row hover state consistently in both widths

top_issues.issue: Quote card disappears inside a hovered message in light mode
top_issues.evidence: Quote fill #eeeef0 equals hover row fill #eeeef0 (sampled 975,385 vs 1100,420); dark keeps #2c2d33 quote on #25262b row
top_issues.fix: Use a distinct quote fill in light, e.g. #e6e6ea on hover rows, or make the light hover row #f4f4f6 so the #eeeef0 quote stays visible

top_issues.issue: Card body leading varies between screens of one flow
top_issues.evidence: Line pitch measured at 20 px (signin, setup, signin-browser), 23 px (signin-device-code), 17 px (signin-finishing)
top_issues.fix: Use one running-text style for card body: 14 pt at 20 px line height everywhere

top_issues.issue: Button padding and radius are inconsistent
top_issues.evidence: 'Sign in with Microsoft' has 16 px side padding; 'Open the page again' 9 px, 'Copy link' 10 px; calendar Copy link/Join are full pills while other buttons use ~6 px radius
top_issues.fix: One button spec: 32 px height, 14 px side padding (12 px with icon), 6 px radius; use pills only for chips

top_issues.issue: Composer scrollbar renders as a detached 3x14 px dark bar next to the attach icon
top_issues.evidence: Bar at x~1166-1169, y~738-752, colour ~#1b1c1f in light, no track; reads as a text caret
top_issues.fix: Place the composer scrollbar at the field's right inner edge (x = right - 4 px) spanning the text area height, thumb #c4c5ca light / #4a4c55 dark, and add a 12 px top fade when scrolled

top_issues.issue: Settings scroll area clips a checkbox at the bottom and uses a heavy always-on thumb
top_issues.evidence: Checkbox top edge visible at y~718 with no fade; thumb 6 px wide #7c7f87 (light) / #82858e (dark), labels end 10 px from it
top_issues.fix: Add a 16 px bottom fade or pad the scroll area to end on a section break; use a 4 px thumb at #c4c5ca / #4a4c55 that appears on hover; keep 16 px between content and thumb

top_issues.issue: Short histories sit low, leaving a large empty band under the header
top_issues.evidence: chats-wide: header bottom 52 px, first divider 173 px (~120 px empty); call-docked: header 132 px, first divider 348 px (~215 px empty)
top_issues.fix: When content is shorter than the viewport and history can load, show a 'Beginning of conversation' marker or load older messages; otherwise cap the bottom-anchored gap at ~48 px

top_issues.issue: Dialogs have no consistent vertical placement
top_issues.evidence: Dialog tops at y=25 (image preview), 70 (settings), 90 (new chat/shortcuts), 120 (status/permission) in an 800 px window; join-on-phone at y=100 collides with the meeting header
top_issues.fix: Centre dialogs at 40% of window height (top = max(48, 0.4*H - h/2)); image preview should use the full window minus 48 px margins

top_issues.issue: Light accent is a muddy rust that collides in hue with away/BRB amber
top_issues.evidence: Accent #9c4b0c (hue ~26 deg) vs away/BRB #8a5a00 (hue ~39 deg); dark accent #e88c3e is a clearly brighter orange, so the brand reads differently per mode
top_issues.fix: Shift the light accent to a cleaner orange that still passes, e.g. #b4530a (5.0:1 with white, measured) or #a5500f (5.6:1), and move away/BRB to a yellow-gold #8f6a00 (5.0:1 on white) with distinct glyphs

top_issues.issue: Calendar list order and detail density
top_issues.evidence: 'Focus time 14:00-16:00 in 3 min' listed below 'Design review 14:21'; detail pane has two rows in a 718x100 card and nothing below y=295
top_issues.fix: Sort by start time (ongoing first); add time, attendees and description sections to the detail pane, max width 640 px

top_issues.issue: List row status and preview disagree
top_issues.evidence: Ada Lovelace row shows 'Not sent' in #b42525 but preview 'Amazing. I'll write the release not...' instead of the failed 'You: Here are the throttling numbers.'
top_issues.fix: Preview the failed outgoing message: 'You: Here are the throttling numbers.'

top_issues.issue: Tiny initials in small avatars and team tiles fall below the 11 pt floor
top_issues.evidence: 26-28 px avatars render initials at ~7-8 pt (popup, switcher, reply rows); chip avatar ~6 pt; team tiles E/P/C ~9 pt
top_issues.fix: Use 11 pt semibold initials for 24-28 px avatars, a single initial for <=20 px chips, and 12 pt for 26 px team tiles

top_issues.issue: Mention popup lacks elevation and looks like it clips the message beneath
top_issues.evidence: Popup at 395-707 x 588-672 covers 'The throttling review is in the En...' with only a 1 px border
top_issues.fix: Give the popup the same shadow as the account menu (0 4 16 rgba(0,0,0,.12) light, .4 dark)

top_issues.issue: Compact call bar uses unlabeled icon buttons with an ambiguous x
top_issues.evidence: 380 px width shows three 40x32 pill icons (phone, monitor, x) with no labels; docked width labels them 'Join on phone', 'Full window', 'Hide call bar'
top_issues.fix: Keep short labels ('Phone', 'Full', 'Hide') or use an 'eye-off' icon for hide so it is not read as Leave

top_issues.issue: Calls page mixes 15 pt explanation with 13 pt capability rows and misaligned Join
top_issues.evidence: 'How calls work' body 15 pt, Works/Not possible rows 13 pt; Join button right edge at 1060 vs card edge 1114 (54 px) while left inset is 16 px
top_issues.fix: Set the explanation to 14 pt / 20 px; stretch the field so Join ends 16 px from the card edge

top_issues.issue: Section headers do not separate groups
top_issues.evidence: 'APP' header at y=342 is 33 px below the last NAVIGATION row, the same pitch as rows
top_issues.fix: Add 16 px above each section header (row pitch 34 px, header gap 50 px)

top_issues.issue: Setup form groups run together and the logo crowds the top
top_issues.evidence: Field bottom 428 to next label 444 (16 px) while label to field is 16 px too; logo at y=20
top_issues.fix: 24 px between field groups, 6 px label-to-field; top margin >= 48 px; fix hint text 'a GUID like the one shown' or show a GUID placeholder

top_issues.evidence: Text starts 7 px from the tooltip's left edge and 8 px from the top; tooltip overlaps the card divider
top_issues.fix: 10 px horizontal, 6 px vertical padding, 13 pt text, max width 280 px
